rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; on the declaration, not the tax reading. i1040sd p. 13, line 14: "If you had any section 1202 gain or collectibles gain or (loss), enter the total of lines 1 through 4 of the 28% Rate Gain Worksheet. Otherwise, enter -0-." The reply lists refuses: [sales.special, sd.other_forms]; sales.special fails type validation ("collection reference requires sum_over"), so triage could not execute the reply. On the reading, its div.box2d equals the project's total of g28 lines 1 to 4 on every return the interview can produce: g28 lines 1 to 3 are div.screen ($0.00; Form 8949 collectibles and section 1202 sales refused by sales.special, Forms 4684, 6252, 6781 and 8824 by sd.other_forms, box 2c by div.section1202) and g28 line 4 is div.box2d (constructed return above: $400.00 on both). The reply's copy skips the worksheet the source names, but it computes the same quantity. No project defect.

Ruling: model error; i1040sd p. 13, line 15: "Enter the (loss), if any, from Schedule D, line 7. If Schedule D, line 7, is zero or a gain, enter -0-"; i1040sd p. 11, Line 19: "If you checked “Yes” on line 17, complete the Unrecaptured Section 1250 Gain Worksheet in these instructions". Triage could not execute this reply (triage/u1250.deepseek.json, state invalid: lines 10, 12 and 14 declare refuses: [sales.special], "collection reference requires sum_over"), so this line is ruled by reading the expression. The candidate's value is the project's when the worksheet is reached (its smaller of sd.line7 and a zero helper equals the project's copy of g28.line6, the smaller of Schedule D line 7 and zero), but the reply declares no shown_when, so it shows Schedule D line 7's loss on returns where line 17 is No; the project hides line 15 behind u1250.reached (sd.line17 true; BUG-0183). The same expression on the same predicate was executed for g28 line 6 (triage/g28.json and g28.deepseek.json: 120 candidate-shows-skipped of 1,659, 25 on completed returns; classm.ltc.1 completed, hidden, candidate -$1,657.00), and u1250.reached and g28.reached are the same test. Under the owner-confirmed skipped-line rule (adjudication README) a nonzero amount shown on a worksheet the filer never reaches is a defect of the side that shows it. The published interface offered shown_when ("a Bool line of the same document") and sd.line17 (Bool), so the source reading was expressible. Project stands.

Ruling: representation; i1040sd p. 13: "If you aren’t reporting a gain on Form 4797, line 7, skip lines 1 through 9 and go to line 10." Line: "Subtract line 2 from line 1". Triage could not execute this reply (triage/u1250.deepseek.json, state invalid: lines 10, 12 and 14 declare refuses: [sales.special], "collection reference requires sum_over"), so this line is ruled by reading the expression. Form 4797 gains and losses are refused by sd.other_forms ("Are there gains or losses from (or that belong on) Forms 4797, 2439, 6252, 4684, 6781 or 8824, or capital gains or losses on a Schedule K-1?"), which refuses Schedule D and Form 1040 line 7a (checked: sd.other_forms true on classm.g28.2 gives sd.line7, g28.line7, u1250.line18 and f1040.line7a refused). The candidate's lines 1 and 2 are ss.zero (declared refused on sd.other_forms), and subtract_floor0 of zero from zero is zero, so the line is $0.00 on every return the interview can produce, as is the project's (div.screen, $0.00); a zero on a line the source skips is permitted, so the candidate's missing shown_when has no effect here. No difference.
